L ESSON 21 / 45 · EARLIER ADDITION
Web workers

A Web Worker runs JavaScript in a separate worker context and communicates by messages. Dedicated
workers cannot directly manipulate the DOM.
CPU-heavy වැඩ main thread එJකන් worker එකකට යවලා UI responsive තියාගෙන්න පුළුවන්. postMessage() වලින් data යවනවා; worker එක result එක ආපසු යවනවා. DOM update කරන්Jන් main thread එJකන්.
Process many records without blocking UI.
Read the diagram: Main thread → postMessage(21) → Worker. Worker → postMessage(42) → Main thread.
Main thread එක worker Jවත 21 යවනවා. Worker එක ගෙණනය කර 42 ආපසු යවනවා.
Expected result: 42, when both files are served correctly from an allowed origin.
Interview question: Can a worker access the DOM?
Answer: No. A dedicated worker communicates with the main thread via messages.
Practice: Send an array to a worker and return its sum; terminate the worker afterward.
